summary: Practise community mapping, resilience assessment and monitoring with CoBRA. Explore the course and strengthen your locally led programme work.
lede: Social capital and resilience training helps practitioners assess community networks and turn local priorities into practical activities. For intermediate-level community resilience, social cohesion, peacebuilding and programme practitioners, it develops skills in stakeholder mapping, inclusive consultation and interpreting survey findings alongside qualitative evidence. Learners also draft community action plans, monitoring frameworks and indicator trackers, and identify when partner delivery may need adaptation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits practitioners who consult communities, coordinate partners or use evidence to plan and monitor cohesion and resilience work.
prerequisites: Prior experience supporting community engagement, resilience, social cohesion, peacebuilding, programme delivery or monitoring is expected. No coding or programming is required.
